{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column for QA rows
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA rows: {len(qa_rows)}")
print(qa_rows[['order_id', 'status', 'revenue']])

# Filter out QA rows (revenue == '999999.99')
df_filtered = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Count completed orders in filtered data
completed_count_filtered = df_filtered['status'].eq('completed').sum()
print(completed_count_filtered)"}
